# FM1 Manager alpha03 synthetic fixture

The files under FM1 were generated by `ManagerContractsTest.kotlinExportFeedsEmbeddedV1AndRecoversBackup` at PR #20 commit `5f56d8721ce56e8d812fe4ca516253f1ec513965`.
The two SLOT files contain synthetic test payloads produced by the same JVM test. They contain no original firmware, backup, or private unit data.

`python3 scripts/verify_manager_card.py tests/fixtures/manager-alpha03/FM1 --files --flat` verifies the frozen fixture.
